page.layout: Two columns of entries on one page. The left column carries the year numbers 1410–1426 in the left margin. The right column carries the year numbers 1427–1441 in the right margin. Below the right column is a parenthesis mark.
page.running_head: Catalogus Hovetmannorum in civitate Groningana, qui judicia per agrum texerunt

main_text.p: 1410Primi hovetmanii, quos mihi nominatos videre contigit, quorum nomina nunc memoriâ meâ exciderunt:

page.notes: The horizontal rules and dashes in the blank entries (1412–1415, 1418–1423, 1425–1426, 1427–1437) are printed rules, not words, so they are not transcribed. The bracket "} eod. anno" and "} CONSS." (1410–1411) and "} eodē āno CONSS." (1424) are braces with their labels, each label given as its own line. The mark at the foot is a printed parenthesis ornament, shown as "()". Reading of "vVigboldes", "Clinge", "Gyffens" and "Casse" is from the scan; the printed spelling of these names may differ slightly. The running head is taken from the title at the top of the page.
